Ut ambulemus] exponitur à Remonstranti-

Jam quæro à vobis, doctores, quid est liben-
ter velle? Estne libere velle, & quid libere
velle vobis est aliud quam ita velle ut possitis
nolle? Ergo Ichovah adlit, ut inclinet animum
ut ambulemus, idem erit atque hoc, Ichovah
adfit ut inclinet animum ut non ambulemus:

page.notes: Small stroke in the right margin beside the line "idem erit atque hoc" (possibly a stray mark or reference mark; no note text printed). Several words are doubtful in the print and are marked [?]: "fuadentem", "fuadentis", "religionis", "indivulse". The line "religionis" may be misread; the word after "fide &" is hard to make out. The Psalm quotation "flecte" is italic and partly unclear. Section numbers 3, 4 and 9 stand inline at the ends of lines and are kept as printed. The catchword "est de-" continues on the next page. The signature "Aa 5" is at the foot.
